# ChemInventory

> ChemInventory is a chemical inventory management system. Track chemical inventory, orders, contacts and batch documents in one app.

ChemInventory (short name CIMS) is made by Junto Technologies.

## Features

- Inventory by batch: Track each batch by CAS number, location, quantity and unit. Search, sort and filter the list.
- Stock ledger: Record purchases, sales, usage, disposal and corrections. Split a batch and keep the link to its parent.
- Orders and contacts: Follow orders through partial deliveries and payments. Import or export orders as CSV. Keep contacts with people and addresses.
- Batch and order documents: Attach COA, specification, GC, NMR, HPLC and IR files to a batch, and quotes, POs and invoices to an order.
- History and dashboard: See who edited inventory, logged transactions and acted on orders, and when. Open dashboard counts and charts by area.
- Roles and price privacy: Assign an Admin, Manager or Chemist role, enforced on the server. Chemists see no prices on transactions or orders.
